ruleDefinitions.name: Root Certificate Installed - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Move\\-Item.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Cert\\:\\\\LocalMachine\\\\Root.*")) OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Certificate.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Cert\\:\\\\LocalMachine\\\\Root.*")))
